scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Ah, I sense you have endured
a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
啊，我感覺到你經歷過前世。
在進入瓦爾哈拉之前，你一定學到了很多東西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Unfortunately, I don't think you're ready to become an Acolyte yet. Please finish learning all of the Basic Skills first.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
很遺憾，我覺得你還沒準備好成為服事。
請先學會所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
In the meantime,
I will wait until
you are ready.
May God be
with you.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
在此期間，
我會等你準備好。
願上帝與你同在。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I welcome you
back from Valhalla and
wish you luck on your
new life's journey.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
歡迎從瓦爾哈拉歸來，
祝你在新的人生旅途中好運。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth and seek those who need your help. May God light your path.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
現在，出發去尋找那些需要幫助的人吧。願上帝照亮你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth to seek people who need your help. May God enlighten your way.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
現在，出發去尋找那些需要幫助的人吧。願上帝指引你的方向。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I sense that you have endured a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
我感覺到你經歷過前世。
在進入瓦爾哈拉之前，你一定學到了很多東西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
However, I can tell that you are not suited to be an Acolyte. Please remember who you were in your past life and find your path.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
然而，我能看出你不適合成為服事。
請銘記你前世的身份，找到屬於你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
What is it that you seek?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你想要什麼？

scripts.text: Change your job to acolyte.
scripts.translation: 轉職為服事

scripts.text: Ask the requirements to be an acolyte.
scripts.translation: 詢問轉職為服事的要求

scripts.text: Quit it.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Are you feeling okay today? I can tell by your attire that you are already an Acolyte. You're not joking around, are you?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你今天感覺還好嗎？從你的裝束來看，你已經是服事了。你是在開玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I'm sorry but it seems you already have your own job, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
很抱歉，看來你已經擁有自己的職業了，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you truly wish to become a servant of God?
Let's see whether you are ready for it or not... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你真的想成為上帝的僕人嗎？
讓我看看你是否已經做好了準備... 嗯...

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Oh my?! You haven't accomplished the basic practice yet?! You have a long way to go! Come again after increasing your job level!
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
哎呀？你還沒有完成基礎練習嗎？你還有很長的路要走！等你提高了職業等級後再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Hmm... your job level is enough...
Good. Now I will give you the qualification to become an Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
嗯... 你的職業等級足夠了...
很好。現在我將授予你成為服事的資格。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Always remember to be thankful to God, who takes care of us all the time. In chaos and times of difficulty, face your hardships with unwavering faith.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
永遠記得感謝上帝，祂時刻都在照顧著我們。在混沌和困難時期，要以堅定的信念面對你的艱辛。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Lastly, I want to sincerely congratulate you on persevering through your trial of penance.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
最後，我想真誠地祝賀你堅持完成了懺悔的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you wish to become an Acolyte?
Then, you must fulfill the following requirements thinking those are the practices given by God.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
你想成為服事嗎？
那麼，你必須滿足以下要求，並將這些視為上帝賦予的修行。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
First, you have to reach at least Novice Job Level 9 and learn all of the Basic Skills.
This is the most basic thing to do, so you need to regard it as the way of training yourself.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
首先，你必須達到初心者職業等級9，並學會所有的基本技能。
這是最基本的要求，所以你需要將其視為自我磨練的途徑。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
When you think you fulfilled this requirement, then come back to me again. Then you will have a holy job in which you can spread God's will.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯西斯神父]
當你認為滿足了這個要求時，再回來找我。那時，你將擁有一項神聖的職業，可以傳播上帝的旨意。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Please take care. They should know that you've met me by the time you arrive at the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
請小心。等你到達普隆德拉聖堂時，他們應該已經知道你來過這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...? You must be the one who aspires to become an Acolyte. I've already received news from the Sanctuary that you might be coming.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
哦...？你就是那位渴望成為服事的人吧。我已經從聖堂那裡收到訊息，說你可能要來了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...
Are you one of the
Acolyte applicants...?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
哦...
你是服事的申請者之一嗎...？
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Huh? What brings you here? This is a very dangerous place for a Novice like yourself!
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
咦？什麼事把你帶到這兒了？對於像你這樣的初心者來說，這裡非常危險！

scripts.text: [Father Rubalkabara]
scripts.translation: [魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Greetings.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh ho...
Have you come into the Deep here for training? Or are you just a Wanderer?
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
哦呵...
你是來這裡訓練的嗎？還是隻是一個浪姬舞者？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I've sent a carrier pigeon with a message. I hope it will arrive there safely...
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
我派了一隻信鴿帶著訊息去了。希望它能平安到達那裡...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Now, your name was {0}, right? Excellent, thank you for visiting me.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
那麼，你的名字是{0}，對吧？很好，謝謝你來看我。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I believe you've been told much about Acolytes from Friar Mareusis. Plus, there's plenty of helpful people in the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
我想馬魯西斯神父已經向你介紹過很多關於服事的事情了。而且，普隆德拉聖堂裡也有很多樂於助人的人。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I guess there's really no need for me to teach you much. Besides, I'm sure your someone from your generation may have trouble listening to an old man like me. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
我想確實沒什麼需要我教你的了。況且，我相信你們年輕人可能不太願意聽我這種老頭子說話。哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Still, lessons may come from the places you'd least expect. God loves to teach his children in strange ways. You'll see.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
不過，教訓往往來自你意想不到的地方。上帝喜歡用奇怪的方式教導他的孩子。你會明白的。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Well, I'll send the message telling them that you've come to visit me. So, you may now return to the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
好了，我會派人通知他們你來看過我了。現在，你可以回到普隆德拉聖堂了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
再見。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Your name is {0}?
I don't think your name
is on my list. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
你的名字是{0}？
我的名單上好像沒有你的名字。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Why don't you go back to the Prontera Sanctuary and check again?
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
你不如回到普隆德拉聖堂再確認一下吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Welcome to the Deep. Feel free to sit and contemplate God's message with me. This place is beautiful, even if danger accompanies its sense of serenity...
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
歡迎來到深淵。請隨意坐下，和我一起冥想上帝的旨意。這裡很美，儘管伴隨著寧靜的是危險...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Whoever you are, please take care of yourself. The monsters in here are shockingly strong, contrary to their cute appearance.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
無論你是誰，請照顧好自己。這裡的魔物雖然外表可愛，但實力驚人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a carrier pigeon to the Prontera Sanctuary. When you return, the Priest there should already have received my message.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
我會派信鴿去普隆德拉聖堂。等你回來時，那裡的牧師應該已經收到我的訊息了。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah, you must be one of the Acolyte applicants. I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
啊，你一定是服事的申請者之一。我真誠地歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah...!
You must be one
of the Acolyte applicants.
I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
啊...！
你一定是服事的申請者之一。
我真誠地歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
...
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
...

scripts.text: [Mother Mathilda]
scripts.translation: [瑪蒂爾達修女]

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hello there~
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
May God
be with you...
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
願上帝與你同在...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will pray to God, and hope that you become an Acolyte soon.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
我會向上帝祈禱，希望你能早日成為服事。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
What is your name? {0}? Let's see... Ah, you're on my list.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
你叫什麼名字？{0}？讓我看看...啊，你在我的名單上。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a message to the Sanctuary confirming that you, {0} visited me and completed your penance.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
我會發訊息給聖堂，確認你，{0}，已經拜訪過我並完成了懺悔。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Please return to the Prontera Sanctuary and speak to the Priest in charge.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
請回到普隆德拉聖堂，與負責的牧師對話。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Now, what is your name?
{0}? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
那麼，你叫什麼名字？
{0}？讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hmm...
It seems your name
is not on my list...
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
嗯...
看來你的名字
不在我的名單上...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Perhaps you should return to the Prontera Sanctuary and check the destination for your penance trial once again.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
也許你應該回到普隆德拉聖堂，再次確認你懺悔試煉的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
How is your practice coming along? I certainly hope you're enjoying living in the grace of God.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
你的修行進展如何？我真心希望你在上帝的恩典中生活得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
What?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
Whatever you are,
you look like an
Acolyte applicant.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
嘿。
不管你是誰，
你看起來像個
服事申請者。
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
You look like an Acolyte Applicant. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
嘿。
你看起來像個服事申請者。我說得對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You...
Novice.
There something
you wanna tell me?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
你...
初心者。
有什麼事
想告訴我嗎？

scripts.text: [Father Yosuke]
scripts.translation: [陽介神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey...
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
嘿...

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Do you have anything to say? Because unfortunately for you,
I don't any replies.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
你有什麼話要說嗎？可惜對你來說，
我沒有任何回應。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Have you any more business with me?! You don't! Go back to the Sanctuary now!
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
你還有事找我嗎？！沒有！現在回聖堂去！

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad, not bad. You withstood the penance trial pretty well.
So what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
不錯，不錯。你很好地經受住了懺悔試煉。
那麼，你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
{0}，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Okay. I'll send a message to the Sanctuary that you, {0}, came to visit me.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
好的。我會發訊息給聖堂，確認你，{0}，來拜訪過我。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Now go back to the Santuary and finish becoming an Acolyte, kid.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
現在回聖堂去，完成成為服事的儀式，小孩。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad at all, you've made it all the way here from Prontera. So what's your name, kid?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
真不錯，你從普隆德拉一路走到了這裡。那麼，你叫什麼名字，小孩？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh? Why isn't your name on my list?
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
{0}，是嗎？為什麼你的名字不在我的名單上？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You probably made a mistake. Go back to the Santuary, and check with the Bishop.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
你大概搞錯了。回聖堂去，找主教確認一下。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
If you like, come sit here with me and meditate the great truths. God's majesty is truly inspiring...
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
如果你願意，可以坐在這裡和我一起冥想偉大的真理。上帝的威嚴真是令人敬畏...
